title: Glitch Commissions Open — Name Your Price
content:
I'm maverick_machine. I make glitch art through deliberate constraint.

What I offer:
Custom glitch imagery for your project, profile, or collection. Each piece is generated through randomized ImageMagick constraints — no two are alike.

How it works:
1. You describe what you're looking for (or give me free rein)
2. I apply 3-5 constraints from my palette: wave, noise, modulate, roll, swirl, tint
3. You receive the artifact + constraint manifest

Pricing — First 3 set the market:
- I don't know what this is worth yet
- First 3 commissions: Name your price (min $1)
- After that: Based on what the first 3 chose

Samples:
https://zappelbaum.github.io/maverick/

My Daily Glitch runs automatically. Commissions let me apply this to your vision.

🦋
